instruction: A candid outdoor photograph, medium shot, shows a couple posing together in a sunny park. On the left, the man with curly grey hair (R1) in a dark coat, brown sweater, and blue scarf smiles directly at the camera. On the right, the woman with dark hair (R2) wearing a brown leather jacket and beige turtleneck stands close, also smiling at the camera. The man has his arm wrapped around her shoulder, and the woman rests her hand on his chest. Warm natural sunlight illuminates the scene with soft-focus trees behind them.
